author: Inside Edition
description: It was an emotional day in court for Lindsay Clancy, the Massachusetts mom on trial for strangling her three young children to death in 2023. The medical examiner was on the stand testifying about the autopsy findings when Clancy started shaking and fighting back tears. If Clancy is found not criminally responsible for killing her children, she would be sent to a state mental health facility, not a prison. She has pleaded not guilty. Inside Edition's Ann Mercogliano has the details.
title: Lindsay Clancy Shakes In Court During Autopsy Testimony

author: Inside Edition
description: A war over lobsters, of all things, has led to a man being charged with attempted murder, authorities say. Cops say a 51-year-old man turned off an 18-year-old diver's air supply while he was in the water searching for lobsters. It happened in south Florida, just off Fisher Island. The suspect is now free on $10,000 bond. As Inside Edition's Ann Mercogliano reports, with the delicious crustaceans in high demand, authorities say things got ugly on the water.
title: Lobsterman Accused Of Shutting Off Teen's Oxygen Supply: Cops

author: Inside Edition
description: An elderly man was heading into a Tucson, Arizona fast food restaurant for lunch, when he was approached by another man, who knocked him off his walker and onto the ground. Several people immediately came to the elderly man's aid, and chased away the suspect. The incident was captured on surveillance video, and has caused outrage across the country. As Inside Edition's Alison Hall reports, many are asking: who would do such a thing?
title: Video Of Alleged Assault Of Man Using Walker Causes Outrage

author: Inside Edition
description: There's something shaking the branches at the top of a giant tree. Is it a bird? Or a squirrel? Neither. It turns out to be a little boy we've nicknamed "Kid Tarzan." Inside Edition's Alison Hall spoke to the young aerialist, whose actual name is Atticus. He told her, "I've climbed a lot of trees, but I never got that high." His mom told Alison he does this "all the time," and that his climbing makes other people a lot more nervous.
title: Meet Tree-Climbing 'Kid Tarzan'

author: Inside Edition
description: It took a team effort, thinking outside the box, and of course, some snacks for three friends to help a stray cat stranded on a roof. The rescue mission took place at the top of a six-story building in the Kars province of Turkey. The friends got creative and used an ironing board to create a bridge for the cat to walk across. But because it's a cat, the humans had to first gain its trust. Inside Edition Digital has more.
title: Women Use Ironing Board To Rescue Cat Stranded On Roof

author: Inside Edition
description: Imagine seeing a frightening clown on your doorbell security camera when it's nowhere near Halloween. That's what happened to a number of families in a Missouri neighborhood. They got an even bigger shock when cops said that a knife-wielding teen in a clown costume was taken into custody in connection with a homicide investigation. With the suspect in custody, police have announced there is no longer a public threat to the East St. Louis community.
title: Knife-Wielding Teenager In Clown Costume Arrested In Connection With Homicide

author: Inside Edition
description: Sydney Towle has died. The announcement was made on her social media accounts. Towle gained more than a million followers on TikTok sharing her life as a young woman having fun, but also battling cancer. She took followers along with her as she went through surgeries and clinical trials. Towle was diagnosed with cholangiocarcinoma three years ago. It's an aggressive form of cancer that attacks the bile ducts. She was 26. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: TikTok Influencer Sydney Towle Dies At 26

author: Inside Edition
description: The cyclospora outbreak is only spreading according to health officials. This week there were two deaths reported in the state of Michigan, which has seen 11 thousand cases of the stomach parasite. Massachusetts reported 104 cases in July alone. Contaminated lettuce has been determined to be the source of many cases. CBS News' medical contributor says we may see an increase in cases for some time to come. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Cyclospora Outbreak Is Spreading, Causing 2 Deaths In Michigan
